corrections.text: The Implications section says that "on LWN, Haas questioned a simple LLM explanation and pointed to the timing of commits" as part of a disagreement over the PostgreSQL 19 delay. LWN's September 10 report describes an August-September mailing-list exchange, before the delay was announced, in which Haas said he was not convinced the problem with Gustafsson's data-checksums patch was as simple as finding more bugs with LLMs. His October 30 blog post, as relayed by Phoronix, later attributes the late release to LLM-found bugs. The two positions differ by date and context rather than being held at the same time.
